item.title: Murray State News Earns Four Awards at Southeast Journalism Conference
item.description: (MURRAY, Ky.) — The Murray State News brought home four awards from the Southeast Journalism Conference, held recently in Cartersville, Georgia — a strong showing for the student publication in its first year competing at the event.

item.title: Murray State Women’s Basketball Cruises to Dominant Road Victory Over Bradley
item.description: (PEORIA, Ill.) — Murray State’s women’s basketball team turned a close first-half contest into a blowout Friday night, defeating Bradley 72-40 at the Renaissance Coliseum to improve to 23-3 overall and 14-1 in Missouri Valley Conference play.
